messages:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up: Aurica customer story kickoff. They agreed to record week of May 3. Need to lock logistics + legal.
Omar Shah: I can propose May 4 11am PT. Will reserve 45m.
Priya Desai: Draft quote ready. Keeping it non-numeric: "Aurica reduced inference turnaround and sped feature delivery". Legal might still ask to soften. @Legal-Bot
Legal-Bot: Please submit aurica-case-draft_v1.docx. Flag: any % or $ figures, and use of Aurica logo. Ticket LR-845 opened. ETA 48 hours.
Kai Wong: Webinar idea: short demo (8m) then product+customer convo (25m). Moderator: Priya or Kai. Also want a 3-slide benchmark appendix (latency, cost, throughput).
Nina Alvarez: Embargo plan: publish 2026-05-10, webinar 2026-05-12 evening (EMEA-friendly time). Can we confirm with the customer?
Morgan Lee (Aurica): (external) May 4 works for the recording. We prefer publish after our Q2 release. Can we keep numbers internal unless we sign off?
Priya Desai: Noted. We'll use qualitative language publicly; include a sales-only appendix with numbers if approved.
Omar Shah: Recording checklist: separate audio tracks, ask for hi-res logo (SVG/PNG), headshot, 2-sentence bio, and a dashboard screenshot.
design-bot: Please upload a 1200x675 hero image and 300x300 logo to /Marketing/CaseStudies/Aurica/assets when received.
Priya Desai: Lead routing: form should capture intent=pilot|buy and product_area=embedding|generation. Route pilot/buy to SDR_hot; others to nurture drip. UTM: utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=aurica-case-2026.
Kai Wong: Sales enablement: Ill create a two-page one-pager + benchmark appendix PDF. Name it aurica-benchmark-appendix-v1.pdf and put in /Sales/Enablement once assets final.
Nina Alvarez: Final approval flow: marketing copy (Priya) -> legal -> customer PM -> marketing publishes. I'll own scheduling and Asana tasks.
Legal-Bot: LR-845 update: reviewer assigned. Please remove any standalone revenue figures from public copy until clearance.
Morgan Lee (Aurica): We'll provide logo and headshot by Tue, and can approve the qualitative quote quickly. For the appendix numbers, we'll need an NDA addendum.
Omar Shah: Noted re NDA. I'll add an asana subtask for legal to prepare addendum if needed.
Priya Desai: Production: rough cut within 48h, social edit 30s + 90s, blog draft (700-900 words).
Nina Alvarez: Great. I'll send calendar invites and the recording brief today. Thanks team :)
